name: Q200v2

published_from.note: files are byte-frozen as used by the campaigns; the only edit is the documented path redaction in artifacts/quality-200.manifest.json

quality-text-180-v2.jsonl.identity_role: this hash is the dataset_sha256 cited in docs/PROCEDURES.md section 1

quality-200.jsonl.note: parent set; quality-text-180-v2 is its exact projection minus the agentic_coding family (asserted by tests/test_q200_v2.py)

quality-200.manifest.json.note: absolute campaign path in the source field replaced with a relative one; all other bytes unchanged

bfcl-v4-multi-turn-hard20-v1.json.interpretation: deterministic structural-complexity proxy subset; not the 20 semantically hardest cases and not an official full-category leaderboard score

harness.scripts/run_quality_set.py: text-quality lane (writes <run-id>.rows.jsonl + <run-id>.summary.json in the working directory)
harness.scripts/close_q200_v2.py: combines text + BFCL summaries into one closure record
harness.scripts/run_bfcl_hard20.py: official bfcl-eval wrapper for the 20-id selection (modes: inspect|run|resume|evaluate|status)
harness.docker/q200_sandbox_driver.py: humaneval sandbox driver, expected inside the candidate image at /opt/r0b0tlab/q200_sandbox_driver.py

rules: frozen contract accepts only finish_reason == stop; length-truncated rows are transport-failed and must be disclosed
hard_reasoning rows are manual-review by design (--manual-evidence) and stay ungraded otherwise
run from the output directory: the lane writes its artifacts relative to the working directory
